Мебгидролина Нападизилат (C19H20N2)2,C10H8O6S2 = 841.0. CAS — 6153-33-9. ATC — R06AX15. ATC Vet — QR06AX15. Profile Mebhydrolin, an ethylenediamine derivative, is a sedating anti- histamine (p.561) with antimuscarinic and sedative properties. It has been given orally as the base or as the napadisilate salt for the symptomatic relief of allergic conditions including urticaria and rhinitis, and in pruritic skin disorders. Granulocytopenia and agranulocytosis have been reported.
